issues.detail: The Hebrew lists 'אֵילִים כָּרִים וְעַתּוּדִים פָּרִים מְרִיאֵי בָשָׁן' (rams, lambs, and goats, bulls, fattened cattle of Bashan). The Chinese renders '巴珊的肥畜、公羊、羊群、公綿羊和公牛' which misorders and misidentifies items: '羊群' (flock) is not in the Hebrew; '公綿羊' (ram) duplicates '公羊' (ram) instead of rendering 'עַתּוּדִים' (goats); '肥畜' (fattened cattle) is placed first instead of 'rams' being first, and 'מְרִיאֵי בָשָׁן' (fattened cattle of Bashan) is split incorrectly. The order and specific animal types are substantively altered.
